name: live6-hosttools
description: Live bundle 6: a mutation-capable stage asked to call the read-only host tools tool_search and list_mcp_resources, then a readOnly stage.

stages.prompt: Do not modify any file. You may call ONLY these two tools, each at most once: tool_search and list_mcp_resources. Do NOT call codemode, do NOT call any tool whose name starts with mcp__ (other than mcp__workflow_artifact__workflow_artifact for your final output), and do NOT call read_mcp_resource or any other tool. 1) List the exact names of every tool you can call. 2) If you have tool_search, call it once with the query "resources" and report the tool names it returns. 3) If you have list_mcp_resources, call it once with no arguments and report the server names it mentions. Report each call's outcome.

Do not modify any file and call no tool except your output tool. List the exact names of every tool you can call, then state in one sentence whether any tool name starts with mcp__ other than mcp__workflow_artifact__workflow_artifact, and whether you have codemode, tool_search or list_mcp_resources.
